title: Senior Pre-Sales Consultant
requiredSkills: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in a similar role, in IT consultancy environment.
Proven track record of successfully solutioning and closing complex software deals.
Proven experience in bid management, proposal development, or related roles within the IT industry.
Strong understanding of business processes and technology solutions, with the ability to translate client requirements into actionable proposals.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate ideas clearly and concisely.
Experience working with clients in the USA and UK is highly desirable.
Previous experience as a Business Analyst, Quality Assurance Analyst, Software Engineer, or in a Pre-Sales role is a plus.
jobDescription: Work closely with the sales team to understand client requirements and develop tailored solutions. Conduct a thorough analysis of client business processes and technical environments. Develop and deliver engaging presentations and proposals that effectively communicate the value proposition of our solutions. Strong understanding of IT services, processes, and methodology. Collaborate with internal teams to develop detailed statements of work and project plans. Produce techno-functional proposals – conceptual and detailed and have a strong sense of business acumen. Keep track of sales leads and opportunities, and actively follow up to ensure timely closure. Provide active support to the sales team throughout the sales cycle, including client meetings, demonstrations, and negotiations. Act as a trusted advisor to clients, offering insights and recommendations to help them achieve their business objectives. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, competitive offerings, and emerging technologies. Provide answers to (technical) questions in a Request for Information (RFI) or a Request for Proposal (RFP) Prepare estimations – effort and cost estimations to augment sales proposals – Support at external and internal customer-facing events – as a technical representative to support business calls – Build custom demonstrations and deliver Proof Of Concepts (POC) Actively participate in internal business/sales team meetings and provide consultative support – Build technical relationships with delivery teams, prospects, or existing customers to support overall prospect/customer engagement. Travel to client sites as needed (domestic and international).

title: Senior System & Network Engineer
requiredSkills: Strong in Linux (RHEL / Ubuntu / CentOS)
Firewall configuration & troubleshooting
Networking concepts: VLAN, NAT, Routing
IPSec VPN configuration
Aruba Access WiFi management
Hyper-V administration
Scripting: Bash / Shell / PowerShell
Basic security & compliance understanding
Veritas or well known Tape drive Backup and restoration
Strong in Active Directory
Moderate level of Knowledge in Data base and Web Server Management
jobDescription: Manage and support end-to-end IT infrastructure operations, including servers, networks, security systems, and user support. Design, deploy, and maintain LAN, WAN, network segments, internet, and intranet systems, ensuring seamless connectivity and high availability across the organization. Administer and maintain network devices and systems including routers, switches, firewalls (Cisco/Sonic Wall/Palo Alto etc), VPN gateways, intrusion detection systems, and wireless infrastructure (Aruba Wi Fi). Configure and manage routing protocols, VLANs, NAT, IP addressing, and network security policies, ensuring optimal performance and secure communication. Implement and manage IPSec VPN tunnels and ensure secure remote connectivity. Administer and maintain Windows (Active Directory, GPO, authentication/authorization) and Linux server environments, ensuring system stability and efficiency. Manage Hyper-V virtualization platform, including VM provisioning, monitoring, and performance optimization. Perform backup and restoration activities using Veritas or tape drive solutions, ensuring data integrity and disaster recovery readiness. Monitor system and network performance, analyze issues, and troubleshoot incidents to ensure minimal downtime and optimal system efficiency. Ensure system and network security, including firewall configuration, patch management, vulnerability assessment, and compliance adherence. Maintain and manage IT assets lifecycle, including hardware, software, licensing, and inventory tracking. Support database and web server environments (basic to moderate level) including installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. Automate routine administrative tasks using Shell/Bash/Power Shell scripting to improve operational efficiency. Identify user needs, provide technical support, and resolve issues reported by users in a timely and effective manner. Maintain system documentation and provide recommendations for infrastructure upgrades, optimization, and scalability. Ensure proper configuration and maintenance of end-user systems, drivers, printers, and peripheral devices.
